entries.message: On the Chromium engine, a link that opens a new window now opens in the Peek or Quick Window it was clicked in.
On the Chromium engine, a new-window link in a Peek or Quick Window now loads once, and still tells the site which page it came from.
A window a link opens on the Chromium engine loads after a few seconds even when Crest never decides where it belongs, instead of staying blank.
A new-window link on the Chromium engine whose Peek or Quick Window has already moved to another page no longer replaces that page.
